segments.en: The brothers are standing in their father's memory inside the Founder's power. Zeke, who is standing, explains that afternoon from above. The content he explains is that Grisha made a child into a tool. He already holds the scene of that making as his own evidence. The position above, which he holds, is the heaven of heaven and earth. Seen from heaven, the father is the one who harmed, and the sons are the ones who were harmed. Zeke thinks that if they are both harmed, they will agree to the same end.

segments.titleEn: Gabi stays on the side of the gun
segments.ja: ガビは、ピークの近くで島の兵を見ています。見ている記憶は、船の一発と、カヤのパンと、ニコロの皿です。皿の怒りは、まだ消えていません。消えていない怒りが、彼女を協力の話から外します。外れた手は、銃のありかを探します。探す理由は、エレンとジークが会えば島の悪魔が完成する、です。完成する前に、彼女は接触を止めたいと思っています。思っている時刻が、地上の本番です。
segments.en: Near Pieck, Gabi is watching the island's soldiers. The memories she is watching are the one shot on the ship, Kaya's bread, and Niccolo's plate. The anger of the plate has not disappeared yet. The anger that has not disappeared takes her outside the story of cooperation. The hand that went outside looks for where a gun is. The reason it looks is that if Eren and Zeke meet, the devil of the island is completed. Before it is completed, she wants to stop the contact. The hour she wants that is the real hour on the ground.

segments.ja: イェレナは、兵団の上官たちにワインの行方を話します。話す行方は、もう飲まれた、です。飲まれた中身は、酒だけではありません。ではありません。ジークの脊髄液が混ざっています。混ざっている相手は、彼の一声で姿を変える人です。変える計画を、彼女は導く者の成功として語ります。語る成功を、オニャンコポンは全部には共有しません。
segments.en: Yelena tells the corps' superiors where the wine went. The whereabouts she tells is that it has already been drunk. What was drunk is not only wine. It is not. Zeke's spinal fluid is mixed in. The people it is mixed into are people whose forms change at one call from him. She tells the plan of changing as the success of a guide. Onyankopon does not share the whole of the success she tells.

segments.en: Armin sets down a number after hearing the talk of the bottles. The number he sets down is how many superiors have already drunk. Pyxis hears the number that is there, including his own cup. The Commander who hears it cannot recall the question in front of the cannon. The reason he cannot recall it is that the person the question was for is no longer in the room of restraint. The Eren who is absent and the Eren who is watching the memory above are the same person. Armin treats the absence of the same person as a crisis on the ground. On the desk he treats, one talk of thunder spears remains.

segments.ja: 地上の兵は、兄弟が会う場所を守ろうとしています。守ろうとする輪は、森で崩れた輪の続きです。続きの中心に、ジークの体があります。ある体へ、エレンが戻れば始祖が動く、とイェレナは言います。言う動きを、ピークはマーレへの合図に変えます。変える合図は、言葉ではなく、位置です。位置を見たガビが、銃を接触の時刻へ合わせます。合わせる詳細は、今日の話では手順にしません。
segments.en: The soldiers on the ground are trying to guard the place where the brothers meet. The ring they are trying to guard is a continuation of the ring that collapsed in the forest. At the center of the continuation is Zeke's body. Yelena says that if Eren returns to the body that is there, the Founder moves. Pieck turns the movement she says into a signal to Marley. The signal she turns it into is not words. It is a position. Gabi, who saw the position, matches a gun to the hour of contact. Today's story does not turn the detail of matching into a procedure.

segments.en: Mikasa is not yet at the center of this hour. The reason she is not is that there is no seat for her above the memory, nor on Pieck's map. Outside the seat that is not there, she is searching for where Eren's body is. The body she is searching for is separate from the mind that is inside the Founder. While it stays separate, the body on the ground is trying to return to the place of contact. A line of a gun is about to cross the back that is trying to return. Before it crosses, her scarf does not arrive. The not arriving is the cruelty of today's earth.

segments.ja: この午後には、終わりが二つあります。ある一つは、ジークの静かな終わりです。もう一つは、ガビが止めようとする接触です。接触が止まれば、始祖は動かず、地鳴らしも名のままです。名のままを、上の兄は望んでいません。望んでいない弟も、まだ自分の終わりを言っていません。言っていないあいだに、地上の位置が揃います。揃う位置は、ピークの合図と、ガビの銃と、兄弟の体です。体が揃ったとき、天地は一つの音になります。
segments.en: In this afternoon, there are two endings. One that is there is Zeke's quiet end. The other is the contact Gabi is trying to stop. If the contact stops, the Founder does not move, and the march of the earth also remains a name. The older brother above does not wish for it to remain a name. The younger brother, who does not wish that either, has not yet said his own end. While he has not said it, positions on the ground line up. The positions that line up are Pieck's signal, Gabi's gun, and the brothers' bodies. When the bodies line up, heaven and earth become one sound.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉です。天地は、記憶の上と地上の下です。ジークは、上から父を原因として説明します。エレンは、下でその説明を置き直します。地上では、ピークが脱出の位置を数えます。ガビは、兄弟の接触を止める側にいます。イェレナは、飲まれたワインと脊髄液を成功として話します。アルミンとピクシスは、その数を聞きます。聞いている午後は、まだ行進ではありません。ではありません。まだ、一つの音の前です。
segments.en: Today's words. Heaven and earth are above the memory and below on the ground. From above, Zeke explains the father as the cause. Below, Eren sets that explanation down again. On the ground, Pieck counts the positions of getting out. Gabi is on the side that stops the brothers' contact. Yelena tells the drunk wine and the spinal fluid as a success. Armin and Pyxis hear that number. The afternoon they are hearing is not yet a march. It is not. It is still before one sound.

vocab.exampleEn: The brothers are standing in their father's memory inside the Founder's power. Zeke, who is standing, explains that afternoon from above. The content he explains is that Grisha made a child into a tool. He already holds the scene of that making as his own evidence. The position above, which he holds, is the heaven of heaven and earth. Seen from heaven, the father is the one who harmed, and the sons are the ones who were harmed. Zeke thinks that if they are both harmed, they will agree to the same end.

In the part he is not looking at that way, there is a moment when the father tried to protect someone. Zeke does not intend to show the moment that is there. He does not. The explanation from above leaves only the material of an argument. The younger brother receives the material that is left and sets it down again. The hand that sets it down again is the earth of heaven and earth.
